question.text:
Extraction of a metal ( $M$ ) from its sulfide ore $\left(M_{2} S\right)$ involves the following chemical reactions:
$\begin{array}{l}
2 \mathrm{M}_{2} \mathrm{~S}+3 \mathrm{O}_{2} \stackrel{\text { heat }}{\longrightarrow} 2 \mathrm{M}_{2} \mathrm{O}+2 \mathrm{SO}_{2} \uparrow \\
\mathrm{M}_{2} \mathrm{~S}+2 \mathrm{M}_{2} \mathrm{O} \stackrel{\text { heat }}{\longrightarrow} 6 \mathrm{M}+\mathrm{SO}_{2} \uparrow
\end{array}$
